key_decisions.rationale: Renders the emphatic oath idiom as categorical refusal without importing a Jonah exception.
key_decisions.before: Sighing deeply in his spirit, he said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”
key_decisions.after: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation demand a sign? Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And sighing deeply in his spirit, he said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Truly I say to you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the private movement, exact bodily actions, and diagnostic question without euphemism.

key_decisions.after: Jesus took the blind man by the hand and led him outside the village. He spat on the man’s eyes, laid his hands on him, and asked, “Can you see anything?”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves partial sight and the unusual walking-tree comparison rather than summarizing blurred vision.
key_decisions.before: The man looked up and said, “I see people; they look like trees walking around.”
key_decisions.after: The man looked up and said, “I can see people. They look like trees walking around.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Looking up, he said, “I see people, because I see them like trees walking around.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves again and the threefold account of restored sight rather than erasing the two stages.
key_decisions.before: Then Jesus placed his hands on the man’s eyes again. The man looked intently, his sight was restored, and he saw everything clearly.
key_decisions.after: Then Jesus laid his hands on the man’s eyes again. The man saw clearly; his sight was restored, and he could see everything distinctly.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Then he again laid his hands upon his eyes, and he looked intently, and his sight was restored, and he saw everything clearly.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves reciprocal shame, the generation’s severe description, and all elements of the coming scene without interpretive expansion.
